title: 1987 Fleer #29 Wade Boggs Boston Red Sox Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1987 Fleer sports trading card features Wade Boggs, a former Major League Baseball player for the Boston Red Sox. The card is a part of the base set and has a card number of 29. It is perfect for collectors who want to add a piece of baseball history to their collection. 

The card is not autographed and is in great shape for its age. It is a must-have for any avid collector or fan of Wade Boggs or the Boston Red Sox. Don't miss out on the opportunity to own a piece of baseball history with this 1987 Fleer sports trading card.
